rationale: The surveyed Ukrainian and Czech academic treatments present the result as a theorem or example derived from compactness, while the Polish and Croatian sources independently confirm the key finite-model and countably-many-constants wording. No stable cross-Slavic specialist calque of the source label was found in the bounded survey. Prěhod k bezkonečnosti therefore names the exact mathematical movement in transparent, dictionary-attested components and remains immediately parsable to Slavic-language readers without importing the misleading computing-overflow or nonstandard-analysis senses of overspill.
